authorities.role: QEMU, Docker, or host compute provider
Celld fleet durability and ownership store

fields.repair_rule: Refresh the cell binding from management and reject older or future generations before any provider invocation.
Look up the management operation by its original operation identity and reconcile the result without issuing a new effect identity.
Refresh inventory from the management provider adapter; desired cell state must not overwrite inventory truth.
Record a new management observation and classify divergence against InstanceCell desired intent.
Refresh enrollment and readiness from the management agent registry and expose any divergence to reconciliation.
After generation validation, reconcile management toward the durable desired intent using idempotent lifecycle operations.
Replay the command record by operation identity and reject any request-hash collision.
Restore alarms from durable cell state and retry lookup or retryable work using the original operation identity.
Resume the monotonic cell event sequence from durable history and preserve management effect evidence as a separate provenance source.
Inspect provider state through management inventory; never infer a compute effect solely from desired intent or transport success.
Restore only versioned, digest-verified cell bytes into an isolated prefix before allowing Celld ownership recovery.
Recover lease state through qualified conditional object-store operations; management must not fabricate ownership.
Accept only the epoch selected by Celld through the object store and fence actors carrying older epochs.
Stop ownership acquisition while storage semantics are impaired, restore qualified conditional writes, and reconcile after fencing recovers.
